title: 第13章 蛇鱼果 上第14章 蛇鱼果 中
slug: 修仙我觉醒了美食系统
content_zh:
窗外暖风揉碎花影，满院春浓；
屋内愁云锁住眉峰，一室闲话。
张大虎先跟林江月讲炼丹的门道，让她更好地理解掺杂的劣质丹药是怎么回事。
“炼丹这事儿，说火候、手法是基础，‘材料’才是关键——下什么料，出什么丹。下品灵草能炼出养气丹，下品妖血也能炼出养气丹。在炼气期弟子看来都是圆溜溜一颗丸子，可里头的‘名堂’却天差地别。”
“就像两碗清澈无味的水，一个清补，一个却火烈。”
讲完了炼丹，他又把赵明玦来找他那事儿，原原本本跟林江月说了一遍。
这时林江月才知道张大虎告知她“关卡”的用意。
“师父意思是，那批炼制的丹药药材故意给错了一味，目的是抓到转卖的人？”
林江月倒吸一口凉气，以后吃丹药一定要从正经渠道获得，不然因小失大。
但她很快打起精神决定帮张大虎出谋划策。
“这一批关卡内抠出的劣质辟谷丹是怎么到赵真人手中的呢？他又为何重视？”
这个问题，张大虎没有回答。
林江月也没有揪着问题不放，而是直指关键。
“赵真人所说的丹药案无论真假，查出来对你都没好处。”
“盘查经过，查明人员后，要么现场抓人，人赃并获。要么搜魂盘问，追根究底。前者耗费人力精力，后者快刀斩乱麻。但这都会引发舆论、牵扯干系。”
张大虎问道：“何出此言？”
林江月说话也不耽误修炼，在床边扎马步练功。
“我觉得问题的关键不是查出谁干了、为什么干。”
“而是要弄清赵真人为什么要查？背后的真实目的究竟是什么？”
“你不清不楚的上来就抓人，万一是圈套呢？”

“这事能混过去就混过去啊师父，别总想着解决问题，和稀泥才是生存之道。”
“实在不行就跑路呗。”
“山高水长，保命要紧。”
张大虎将被子、坛子、凳子架在林江月头顶增加重量，帮她健体，又接着说。
“我倒是想跑，那你呢？我可放心不下。”
“哎哟哟，师父你别加了，你怎么能一边问话一边施压呢？”
林江月丢下最后一句，便放下头顶它物，坐在床边开始吐纳灵力。
“我不同你讲了，你自个寻思去……”
张大虎嘿嘿一笑，捡起掉落的衣物，转身离开。
见他离去，林江月睁开眼睛，腮帮子鼓起，手撑在床上，仰头望天。
长叹一声。
content_en:
The warm breeze outside the window ruffles the shadows of flowers, and the courtyard is full of spring;
In the house, the gloomy clouds locked the eyebrows, and the whole room was chatting.
Zhang Dahu first talked to Lin Jiangyue about the art of alchemy, so that she could better understand what happened to adulterated inferior elixirs.
"When it comes to elixir refining, the heat and technique are the basis, and the 'materials' are the key - what ingredients are used, what elixir will come out. Low-grade spiritual grass can make Qi-nourishing pills, and low-grade demon blood can also make Qi-nourishing pills. To the disciples in the Qi-refining stage, they all look like round balls, but the 'names' inside are completely different."
"Like two bowls of clear and tasteless water, one is refreshing and tonic, while the other is fiery."
After talking about alchemy, he told Lin Jiangyue exactly what happened when Zhao Mingjue came to see him.
Only then did Lin Jiangyue know the purpose of Zhang Dahu telling her about the "level".
"Master, what you mean is that the batch of refined elixirs and medicinal materials were deliberately mixed with the wrong ingredients, in order to catch the person who resold them?"
Lin Jiangyue took a breath of cold air. In the future, pills must be obtained from legitimate channels, otherwise they will lose a lot.
But she quickly cheered up and decided to help Zhang Dahu make suggestions.
"How did the low-quality Bigu Pills extracted from this batch of levels get into the hands of Master Zhao? Why does he pay attention to them?"
Zhang Dahu did not answer this question.
Lin Jiangyue did not dwell on the problem, but pointed to the key point.
"Whether the pill case mentioned by Master Zhao is true or false, it will not do you any good to find out."
"After the investigation, after the person is identified, either the person is arrested on the spot and the stolen goods are recovered. Or the person is searched and interrogated to get to the bottom of the matter. The former consumes manpower and energy, while the latter cuts through the mess quickly. But this will cause public opinion and get involved."
Zhang Dahu asked: "Why do you say this?"
Lin Jiangyue didn't delay her practice even though she was talking, and practiced walking on horseback beside the bed.
"I think the key is not to find out who did it and why."
"But to find out why Zhao Zhenren wants to investigate? What is the real purpose behind it?"
"You come up and arrest people without knowing anything. What if it's a trap?"
"If you can get over it, just get over it, Master. Don't always think about solving the problem. The only way to survive is to be in harmony with the mud."
"If it doesn't work, just run away."
“The mountains are high and the rivers are long, it’s important to stay alive.”
Zhang Dahu put the quilt, jar, and stool on Lin Jiangyue's head to add weight to help her keep fit, and then continued.
"I want to run away, but what about you? I can't rest assured."
"Ouch, Master, please stop adding. How can you ask questions and put pressure on me at the same time?"
After Lin Jiangyue said the last sentence, she put down everything else on her head, sat on the edge of the bed and began to breathe out her spiritual power.
"I won't tell you anymore, you can figure it out on your own..."
Zhang Dahu chuckled, picked up the fallen clothes, turned and left.
Seeing him leaving, Lin Jiangyue opened her eyes, puffed up her cheeks, put her hands on the bed, and looked up at the sky.
A long sigh.
